// ruleid: in-process-cache-javascript
import { LRUCache } from "lru-cache";

const WORD = /\w+/;
const SPLIT = new RegExp(",");

export class Parser {
  static WORD = /\w+/;

  parse(text: string) {
    // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
    return /a+b/.test(text);
  }
}

export function words(text: string, pattern: string, total: number, parts: number) {
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const found = /a+b/i.test(text);
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const global = /x/i.test(text) && /day/g.test(text) && /x/gi.test(text) && text.replace(/x/gu, "") === "";
  const ratio = total / parts / 2;
  const path = "Error: /tmp/ is missing"; // see /docs/ for more
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-javascript
  const built = new RegExp("a+b");
  const dynamic = new RegExp(pattern);
  // ruleid: bool-array-javascript
  const seen = new Array(text.length).fill(false);
  return [found, global, ratio, path, built, dynamic, seen, WORD, SPLIT, LRUCache];
}

export async function load(blocks: Db, session: Db, db: Db, users: Db, orders: Db, ids: string[], base: string, links: Link[]) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.get(id);
  }
  for await (const row of db.stream()) {
    await db.put(row);
  }
  for await (const row of db.stream()) await db.put(row);
  for await (const chunk of db.stream({
    from: base,
    to: base,
  })) {
    await db.put(chunk);
  }
  for await (const chunk of db.stream(
    base,
  )) {
    await db.put(chunk);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.remove(id);
  }
  while (true) {
    await db.take();
  }
  let cursor = await db.page("");
  while (cursor) {
    cursor = await db.page(cursor);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (await db.has(id)) {
      break;
    }
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    await db.put(id);
    await sleep(100);
  }
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const first = await users.get("a");
  const second = await orders.get("b");
  console.log(second);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const user = await db.get("a");
  const org = await db.get("b");
  console.log(org);
  const left = await session.get("a");
  const right = await session.get("b");
  console.log(right);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const top = await blocks.get("a");
  const bottom = await blocks.get("b");
  const total = first + second;
  const third = await db.get(total);
  const fourth = await db.get(third);
  for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 2) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all(ids.slice(start, start + 2).map(db.get));
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.put(ids[start]);
  }
  for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 2) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.get(ids[start]);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all([db.get(id), users.get(id)]);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (await db.has(id)) throw new Error(id);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    later(async () => {
      await db.put(id);
    });
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await db.get(id);
  }
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await Promise.all([db.get(id), users.get(id)]);
    later(async () => {
      await db.put(id);
    });
  }
  await db.run(async () => {
    for (const id of ids) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await db.get(id);
    }
  });
  const cached: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const id of ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    cached[id] ??= await db.get(id);
  }
  console.log(cached);
  const covers = await db.get("covers");
  const perId = await Promise.all(ids.map(async (id) => {
    const row = await db.get(id, covers);
    return row;
  }));
  console.log(perId);
  const head = await db.get("head");
  const tail = await Promise.all(ids.map((id) => db.get(id, head)));
  console.log(tail);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
  const alone = await users.get("x");
  const others = await Promise.all(ids.map(async (id) => db.get(id)));
  console.log(alone, others);
  // ruleid: url-parse-in-loop-javascript
  const same = ids.map((id) => new URL(base).host === id);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const trimmed = id.trim();
    same.push(new URL(trimmed).host === base);
  }
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(links)) {
    same.push(new URL(value).host === key);
  }
  return [fourth, user, org, left, right, top, bottom, same, ids.map((id) => new URL(id).host), links.map(({ href }) => new URL(href))];
}

export function queries(db: Db, prisma: Prisma, supabase: Supabase, args: object) {
  return [
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    supabase.from("users").select("*"),
    supabase.from("users").select("id,name"),
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    db.select().from(usersTable),
    db.select({ id: usersTable.id }).from(usersTable),
    // ruleid: whole-row-query-javascript
    prisma.user.findMany({ where: { active: true } }),
    prisma.user.findMany({ where: { active: true }, select: { id: true } }),
    prisma.user.findMany(args),
    // ruleid: json-column-javascript
    jsonb("settings"),
    db.response.json(),
    db.header("application/json"),
    // ruleid: json-column-javascript
    db.raw("SELECT data->>'k' FROM users"),
    db.raw("INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM users"),
    db.raw("SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)"),
    // ruleid: whole-row-sql
    db.raw("SELECT * FROM users"),
  ];
}

async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

async function inOrderSteps(steps, { reason }) {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }, extra: string): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

async function inOrderWithoutReason(items, step) {
  for (const item of items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await step(item);
  }
}

class OtherOrder {
  async inOrder(items, step, options) {
    for (const item of items) {

      await step(item);
    }
  }
}

async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }, extra) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

async function inOrderSteps(steps, options) {
  for (const step of steps) {

    await step();
  }
}

async function reviewedOrder(items, client, orders, reason) {
  await inOrder(items, async (item) => {
    // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
    const first = await client.get(item);
    const second = await orders.get(item);
    console.log(first, second);
    for (const child of item.children) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
      await client.get(child);
    }
  }, { reason: "Each update reads the previous write" });
  await inOrderSteps([
    async () => {
      // ruleid: sequential-awaits-javascript
      const first = await client.get("a");
      const second = await orders.get("b");
      console.log(first, second);
    },
  ], { reason: "Each stage needs the preceding stage" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, client.put, { reason });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, client.put);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([]);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, client.put, { reason: "" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "too short" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrder(items, client.put, { reason: "singlewordlongerthantwentycharacters" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "                       " });
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "1234567890 123456789" });
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: 'Each stage needs the preceding stage' });
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "Each writer's result feeds the next" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "123456789 123456789" });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: `The order is ${reason}` });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: 12345678901234567890 });
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
  await inOrderSteps([], { reason: "singlewordlongerthantwentycharacters   " });
}

function hiddenSequence(items, client) {
  // ruleid: hidden-sequential-loop-javascript
  return items.reduce((previous, item) => previous.then(() => client.put(item)), Promise.resolve());
}

function ordinaryReduce(items) {
  return items.reduce((total, item) => total + item, 0);
}

function nonChainedPromises(items, client) {
  return items.reduce((previous, item) => client.put(item), Promise.resolve());
}
